name: publicWeb_setRunRsvp
description: RSVP from the public web (E9.F7.S1). The browser is a registered HC.Device, so this is the app's own hcapp_setEventRsvp; the wrapper maps PublicEventId to the run and checks the state. The inner SP validates the token (signed for 'hcapp_setEventRsvp'), defaults the hasher to the caller (@hasherId NULL), leaves the hare flag alone (@isHare -1), auto-sets notifications, and does everything the app's RSVP does: run counts, sequence numbers, notification defaults. Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The calling browser's HC.Device id (the browser is a registered device). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Device-bound token signed for 'hcapp_setEventRsvp' (the inner SP validates it under its own name via HC6.ValidateAppAuth). No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run (deleted = 0, removed = 0). No SQL default.

parameters.name: rsvpState
parameters.description: 1 No, 2 Maybe, 3 Yes. No SQL default.
parameters.typeMismatch: Column is SMALLINT; the parameter is INT — checked IN (1,2,3) first, so nothing is lost.

rowsets.name: WrapperRefusal
rowsets.description: Wrapper refusal before the EXEC: run unknown/deleted/removed or @rsvpState not 1/2/3 → { success 0, errorCode 1200, errorType 12 }, logged to HC.ErrorLog.
Follows WrapperRefusal: errorTitle 'Run not found', errorUserMessage 'That run could not be found.'

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: From hcapp_setEventRsvp: Always the first rowset, on every path including auth failure.

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 on success (including the 'already checked in' and 'nothing changed' outcomes), 0 on any error.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. ValidateAppAuth code; 1226 hemId/eventId mismatch; 1926 unhandled.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 1 bad token / 3 device not found / 7 signed out (ValidateAppAuth); 12 validation; 19 unhandled (CATCH).

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: From hcapp_setEventRsvp: Rowset 1 on failure only. Every path writes HC.ErrorLog.

rowsets.name: AdHocRsvpResult
rowsets.description: From hcapp_setEventRsvp: Rowset 1 on success (lines 325-334), including the two no-change outcomes. Row values are re-read by EventId + UserId after the write.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: '' on a write. '<name> is already checked in at the Hash. The RSVP can no longer be changed.~~To change the RSVP, you must first mark <name> as being not at the Hash.' when attended and the RSVP differs; 'The RSVP status has not changed for <name>' when nothing changed. '~~' separates sentences.

columns.name: hasherEventMapId
columns.description: HasherEventMap.id (new or existing). Not lowercased — the app's lowerGuidsInPlace handles it.

columns.name: hares
columns.description: The rebuilt Event.Hares text — only when the hare flag changed AND the text was this SP's own to rebuild. NULL when the flag did not change and NULL when a name was appended to admin-typed text (the client must not treat NULL as 'no hares').

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData
rowsets.description: From hcapp_setEventRsvp: Rowsets 2+ on success: HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData for @eventId with the HEM/HKM watermarks passed through and hashers, narrow events, payments, kennel credits and receipts 'ignore'. See that contract. The wrapper passes '2050-01-01' for both watermarks, so these rowsets come back empty.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET RsvpState, IsHare, EventNotificationPreference, EventEmailAlertPreference (each COALESCEd), updatedAt WHERE id = @hemId — when the RSVP or hare flag changes before attendance, or only the hare flag changes after it (lines 207-231).
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap (RsvpState = @rsvpState, IsHare, VirginVisitorType 0, EventNotificationPreference, KennelId from HC.Event) when the hasher has no row on the event (lines 232-247).

UPDATE HC.Event SET Hares, updatedAt when the hare flag changed (lines 265-291): rebuilt from flagged hares (IsHare = 1 AND RsvpState = 3) only when the current text is empty or equals that aggregate as it stood before the change; admin-typed text is never replaced and gains a newly flagged hare's DisplayName if absent (1.1.0, 2026-09-28 — before, a flagged hare RSVPing No replaced typed co-hares wholesale).
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser @userId = @hasherId after COMMIT, outside the TRY, on every successful call (line 311).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the hemId/eventId mismatch (line 102) and in the CATCH (line 300); HcVersion from HC6.DeviceHcVersion(@deviceId).
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData after the adHocData rowset (line 342).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the wrapper refusal (1200).

On an error that escapes the inner SP the CATCH rolls back, logs 'Unhandled error in publicWeb_setRunRsvp' to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<web>', deviceId) and returns { success 0, errorCode 1500, errorType 5 } alone (no detail rowset).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @publicEventId, @rsvpState (line 2-5) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
